policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: G: model deprecation timeline update
items.summary: G’s deprecations docs show planned shutdown for specific G Compound model IDs (requests error after the stated date). This can affect developer workloads and near-term retention, but is manageable with migrations.

items.headline: O: FTC subpoenas
items.summary: AP reports multiple states allege O’s chatbot violates consumer protection laws; the matter includes claims about deceptive behavior and harmful outputs, increasing legal/regulatory overhang near commercialization.

items.headline: O: fundraising push at higher growth trajectory
items.summary: Reuters (via Investing.com) says O is seeking to accelerate fundraising before Anthropic’s IPO disclosures, citing GPT-6 Astra-driven acceleration and revenue expectations of $50B-$70B annualized.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 for everyone
items.summary: O released GPT-6 “for everyone,” signaling continued product rollout and distribution expansion. This supports near-term usage growth assumptions, though it doesn’t quantify revenue or margin impact in the release.
